basic_details.short_information: Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) is recruiting candidates for Staff Nurse posts on a contract basis through A1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. Eligible female candidates holding General Nursing and Midwifery or B.Sc. (Nursing) with a valid Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC) Registration certificate can attend a walk-in interview on Thursday, 29th October, 2026, reporting at 9:00 a.m. to 09:30 a.m. at 3rd Floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210. The pay for the Staff Nurse post is Rs. 33,000/- per month for GNM

age_limit.details: Should not exceed 35 years at the time of interview.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: General Nursing and Midwifery and / OR B.Sc. (Nursing) preferably with one year clinical experience. Candidate should have a valid Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC) Registration certificate. Hepatitis ‘B’ Vaccination (all doses) Certificate is compulsory.

qualification.details: Should not exceed 35 years at the time of interview.

salary_details.details: Consolidated salary is Rs. 33,000/- per month for GNM freshers and Rs. 35,000/- per month for B.Sc. (Nursing) freshers. Candidates will be given one time additional amount @ Rs. 1,500/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred only) for every completed year of experience.

content_sections.heading: About ACTREC Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: An outsourced Contractor for Manpower Services, A1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., is looking for Staff Nurse to be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410 210.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Should not exceed 35 years at the time of interview.

rows.qualification_required: General Nursing and Midwifery and / OR B.Sc. (Nursing) preferably with one year clinical experience. Candidate should have a valid Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC) Registration certificate. Hepatitis ‘B’ Vaccination (all doses) Certificate is compulsory.
rows.consolidated_salary: Rs. 33,000/- per month for GNM; Rs. 35,000/- per month for B.Sc. (Nursing)

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Staff Nurse Salary and Additional Benefits
content_sections.text: Consolidated salary is Rs. 33,000/- per month for GNM freshers and Rs. 35,000/- per month for B.Sc. (Nursing) freshers. Candidates will be given one time additional amount @ Rs. 1,500/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred only) for every completed year of experience.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph Scanned copies of Aadhaar Card, PAN CARD ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification certificates Experience certificates MNC registration Hepatitis ‘B’ Vaccination certificate

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates fulfilling above requirements may walk in for interview on Thursday, 29th October, 2026 at, 3rd Floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210 along with Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhaar Card, PAN CARD, ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification certificates, experience certificates, MNC registration and Hepatitis ‘B’ Vaccination certificate. In case of receipt of more applications, MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview, accordingly. Reporting Time: 9:00 a.m. to 09:30 a.m.
